bible.tokens: warm paper grey, no colour accents
project.bible.lighting_rules: Scenes 1-2: soft grey evening; the pale road is the brightest value. Scenes 3-5: flat, clean 9 AM morning that arrives without transition. No dramatic cast shadows, no horror lighting, no glow or particle effects at the threshold.
project.world_logic: Third-person dream: the dreamer watches himself from outside. Evening becomes morning at the school without explanation. At the doorway the child and carrier vanish and the adult is in school uniform; nothing announces it. The world collapses like damaged film; the waking world is never shown.
project.negative_prompts: colour accents, glossy digital painting, photorealism, generic fantasy fog, horror lighting, floating symbols, expository text, labels, real school crest, modern black outerwear, phone, mirror

The White Road.sound.ambient: wind in enormous roadside trees; distant period two-strokes; a few birds
The White Road.mood: anxious pursuit under an ordinary sky
The White Road.atmosphere: light wind moving branches; dry road dust

No Ride Stops.sound.ambient: auto-rickshaw engines receding; a horn far off; the same wind
No Ride Stops.mood: opportunity always moving the other way

Nine O’Clock.sound.ambient: morning birds; no traffic; a faint clock mechanism
Nine O’Clock.atmosphere: clear dry morning that arrives without transition

The Door Is for You.sound.ambient: near silence; a single held room tone inside the stone entrance

The Scene Collapses.sound.ambient: room tone thinning to projector hum and emulsion crackle
The Scene Collapses.atmosphere: paper grain and registration coming apart

The road before Abhishek.beat.purpose: Establish the remembered road as a place before anyone is in it.
The road before Abhishek.beat.visual_point: The road is the brightest thing; the trees move and nothing else does.
The road before Abhishek.beat.theme: old Bangalore remembered as space and wind, not exposition
The road before Abhishek.transition: hold, then Abhishek enters on the next cut

Abhishek enters the frame.beat.purpose: Introduce the adult, the child and the carrier in one entrance, already running.
Abhishek enters the frame.beat.visual_point: A small figure enters the huge frame from the left, mid-stride, chest first.
Abhishek enters the frame.performance.body_language: forward lean, arms braced around the carrier
Abhishek enters the frame.performance.gaze: down the road, right of frame

Running against traffic.beat.purpose: The poster image: he runs one way, everything else moves the other.
Running against traffic.beat.visual_point: Counterflow — autos left, Abhishek right, trees bending over both.
Running against traffic.beat.theme: no one is going where he is going
Running against traffic.performance.body_language: steady running stride, torso protective of the child
Running against traffic.sound.sfx: two auto engines passing left; his breathing under them
Running against traffic.sound.music: none yet — hold for scene three
Running against traffic.transition: lateral track carries into the profile

The quiet passenger.beat.purpose: Show the carrier and the child's quietness as one silhouette.
The quiet passenger.beat.visual_point: Profile: the child's outline against his pale shirt does not move.
The quiet passenger.beat.theme: the calm he is running for is right against him
The quiet passenger.performance.body_language: one hand on the carrier strap
The quiet passenger.sound.sfx: footfalls; fabric of the carrier; no sound from the child

No sound from the child.beat.purpose: Put the anxious adult face and the quiet child in one frame.
No sound from the child.beat.visual_point: Two faces, one tense and one neutral, sharing the frame.
No sound from the child.beat.theme: the child's silence is the strangest thing in the dream
No sound from the child.performance.gaze: flicking ahead and to the side
No sound from the child.sound.sfx: his breath close; the road far

Transport moving away.beat.purpose: Make transport visible and unavailable without a hail or a word.
Transport moving away.beat.visual_point: Vehicles form one clean vector out of frame, away from his route.
Transport moving away.beat.theme: the city keeps its own direction
Transport moving away.transition: pan left ends on empty road

Searching for transport.beat.purpose: He looks for a ride while never stopping.
Searching for transport.beat.visual_point: His head turns while his legs do not.
Searching for transport.beat.theme: the deadline exists before its task
Searching for transport.performance.gaze: over his shoulder at the receding autos

An auto crosses the frame.beat.purpose: An auto hides him for a moment; when it clears he is still running.
An auto crosses the frame.beat.visual_point: Occlusion, then the same figure in the same stride.
An auto crosses the frame.beat.theme: the city passes through him without stopping
An auto crosses the frame.sound.sfx: auto engine loud in foreground, then gone

Keep running.beat.visual_point: Compressed road layers; the figure barely moves against them.
Keep running.sound.music: a single low held tone begins under the wind

Arches through the trees.beat.purpose: First sight of the destination, partial, through movement.
Arches through the trees.beat.visual_point: Stone arches and a clock tower glimpsed between moving branches.
Arches through the trees.beat.theme: the school is a role waiting, not a place arrived at

Arrival at the old school.beat.purpose: The school in full, and evening has become morning without transition.
Arrival at the old school.beat.visual_point: Flat morning light on grey stone where the last cut was evening.
Arrival at the old school.beat.theme: dream logic enters through light, not effect
Arrival at the old school.sound.sfx: morning birds; the traffic is gone

Exactly nine.beat.visual_point: A clock face, exactly 9:00, second hand motionless.
Exactly nine.sound.sfx: a faint clock mechanism; no tick

Checking the deadline.beat.purpose: Put him and the clock in one composition and one eyeline.
Checking the deadline.beat.visual_point: Profile foreground-left, clock upper-right, both sharp.
Checking the deadline.beat.theme: he already knows he is late for something

Running under the arches.beat.visual_point: Repeating arches receding; a rear three-quarter figure moving into them.
Running under the arches.transition: cut to the locked doorway frame

Before the doorway.beat.purpose: The locked frame that everything after must match.
Before the doorway.beat.visual_point: Centered doorway; adult clothes, toddler, carrier, all present and clear.
Before the doorway.beat.theme: everything he carries, shown once, plainly

Last view of the child.beat.purpose: Confirm the child, the carrier and both straps one last time.
Last view of the child.beat.visual_point: Infant scale against the pale shirt; two straps.
Last view of the child.beat.theme: what is about to be gone
Last view of the child.performance.gaze: the child looks at nothing in particular
Last view of the child.transition: cut back to the exact locked frame

Crossing the line.beat.purpose: He crosses the threshold with everything still there.
Crossing the line.beat.visual_point: Same frame as before the doorway; one step forward; child and carrier present.
Crossing the line.beat.theme: the ordinary side of a line
Crossing the line.transition: straight cut; nothing announces the change

After the doorway.beat.purpose: The turn: same frame, same man, uniform, no child, no carrier.
After the doorway.beat.visual_point: Exact geometry of the previous frame with only wardrobe changed and the chest empty.
After the doorway.beat.theme: the adult is returned to being the student
After the doorway.performance.body_language: same mid-step, arms now holding nothing

The school was for Abhishek.beat.visual_point: Hands at an empty chest; a uniform on an adult body.
The school was for Abhishek.beat.theme: the school was for him all along
The school was for Abhishek.performance.body_language: hands checking the chest, turning at the waist
The school was for Abhishek.performance.gaze: down at himself, then around the entrance

The school grows too large.beat.purpose: The building begins to be wrong around him.
The school grows too large.beat.visual_point: Realistic stone, subtly oversized; the figure smaller than it should be.
The school grows too large.beat.theme: the role is bigger than the person

The frame loses alignment.beat.purpose: The world comes apart before he does.
The frame loses alignment.beat.visual_point: Arches, clock geometry and grain out of register; Abhishek still coherent.
The frame loses alignment.beat.theme: the picture, not the man, is failing

Collapse.beat.purpose: End where the dream ends: the image runs out.
Collapse.beat.visual_point: Stone folds inward; the man is the last recognisable thing, then grey.
Collapse.performance.gaze: toward camera for the first time, briefly
Collapse.sound.sfx: film running out; the hum stops
